Title: To verify search popup opens successfully for each Tax Level 1-4 ID
Steps:
1. Login with CAS admin access.
2. Navigate to Company Application Settings.
3. Search Tax section.
4. Set Tax Type dropdown to "Tax Authority Levels".
5. Click search (magnifying glass) for Tax Level 1 ID, Tax Level 2 ID, Tax Level 3 ID, Tax Level 4 ID one by one.
6. Open Show Tax Level Fields dropdown and select "Show 4 Fields".
7. Save CAS settings.
8. Reopen Tax section and verify displayed fields.
Test Data: Company with Tax Type = Tax Authority Levels; Tax Level 1-4 IDs configured; Show Tax Level Fields = Show 4 Fields
Expected Outcome: Search popup opens successfully for each Tax Level 1-4 ID. All four tax level fields are displayed. Setting "Show 4 Fields" is saved and retained on reopen.
